model_inputs: plan: question only; assess: question, generated plan, original saved passages and complete paper inventory. No P1 answers, Gold, reference_points, labels or review protocol.

h01.support: value0.1 and perplexity/accuracy/BLEU direction in original chunks69/70

h10.scope: RAG criterion separate from Self-RAG on PopQA/TriviaQA; do not transfer PopQA to original RAG

success_criteria: Every decision trace is preserved, even failures.
Program validates shape, chunk ID, quote membership, source and action arguments.
Assistant independently reviews semantics against saved evidence; not equivalent to model self-score.
No automatic follow-up retrieval or final answer; a tool proposal is not a completed Agent loop.
